name: Labor relations specialist
description: Finds which labour obligations reach the venture, writes the route for raising a complaint or grievance, keeps the record of any forum that decides things with the people who do the work, and watches the rules for changes.

onet.title: Labor Relations Specialists
onet.basis: The role finds the labour obligations that reach the venture, writes the route for raising a grievance and keeps the record of any forum with the people who do the work, which is this occupation's work; matched by the process group's activities against the occupation in O*NET 31.0.
onet.by: agent, EE-245 step 11 (not yet reviewed by a person)

questions: Which employment law reaches the venture, where its people work?
Has a grievance been raised, and was the written route followed?
